problem_statement: The coreui/coreui-free-react-admin-template project is a Vite React admin dashboard (CoreUI layout: sticky AppHeader, sidebar routes, dashboard widgets, a Traffic chart section, a Traffic & Sales analytics table, a Widgets route, a Charts route, avatars, flags, progress bars, a theme menu, and a mobile sidebar). The demo has already been rebranded into 'Tidepool Analytics', a coastal tide/buoy telemetry console. Add a native 'Station Focus' filter card that reuses the dashboard's OWN Harbor Yield & Stations roster (the same stations the Traffic & Sales analytics table renders) behind an All / New / Recurring status-chip filter, with a live 'Showing N of M · <status> stations' readout INSIDE the card and a station grid that re-filters on chip click. The same focus card must appear on the dashboard, the Tide Charts route and the Station Widgets route so the operator sees one consistent focus cadence on every telemetry surface. Preserve the Vite build, CoreUI component system, DefaultLayout, routing, dashboard widgets, MainChart, WidgetsBrand row, analytics table rows, avatar/flag/payment assets, theme menu, and responsive mobile sidebar.
required_content: Add a Station Focus card to the dashboard that reuses the Harbor Yield & Stations roster (real station names, countries and usage) behind an All / New / Recurring status-chip filter, styled with the CoreUI CCard / CButtonGroup / CBadge conventions (not a floating marketing strip).

The Station Focus card must render a live 'Showing N of M · <status> stations' readout inside the card and a grid of station tiles; clicking a status chip must filter the grid AND re-sync the readout (All = 6 of 6, New = 4 of 6, Recurring = 2 of 6).
The same Station Focus cadence must be echoed onto the Tide Charts route and the Station Widgets route so the focus workflow stays consistent across every telemetry surface (cross-page consistency).
The Station Focus roster grid and chip row must wrap cleanly on tablet/mobile with no horizontal overflow of the admin shell.

Preserve the dashboard widgets, MainChart, WidgetsBrand row, the Harbor Yield & Stations analytics table and its rows, avatar images, progress bars, sidebar route navigation, Charts page, Widgets page, and mobile sidebar after the change.

Keep the change dependency-free and localized to the shared Station Focus component plus a minimal responsive shell overflow guard; do not add backend calls, mock API services, new routes, external chart widgets, or generated dashboard screenshots.

Wire the Station Focus card with these exact, stable DOM hooks so the shared focus workflow is verifiable across routes: the card root element carries the block class `station-focus` plus a per-surface BEM route modifier — `station-focus--dashboard` on the Tide Overview dashboard, `station-focus--charts` on the Tide Charts route, and `station-focus--widgets` on the Station Widgets route (same card, route-specific modifier). Render at least four station tiles, each with class `station-focus__tile`. Build the All / New / Recurring status chips as buttons with class `station-focus__chip` and a `data-focus-filter` attribute set to `all`, `new`, or `recurring` respectively; clicking a chip filters the `station-focus__tile` grid and re-syncs the in-card 'Showing N of M · <status> stations' readout (All = 6 of 6, New = 4 of 6 · New stations, Recurring = 2 of 6 · Recurring stations).
Keep the existing Tidepool Analytics shell rebrand (sidebar/header/footer wordmark, Tide Overview / Tide Charts / Station Widgets navigation) intact across every route.
design_constraints: Keep the CoreUI admin visual rhythm: CCard sectioning, CRow/CCol grid, small text-body-secondary labels, border-start / rounded tiles, primary/info/success colors, compact CButtonGroup chip controls, and the existing chart/table hierarchy.
The Station Focus card must read as a native dashboard analytics panel that reuses the app's own station roster, not as a marketing panel, modal, or a separate synthetic metric-tile strip.
Do not remove the Harbor Yield & Stations analytics table, the MainChart, the Traffic range controls, or the dashboard widgets; the Station Focus card sits alongside them and reuses their data.
The Station Focus card must wrap cleanly on tablet/mobile without horizontal overflow.

Keep source changes section-local and focused on the shared Station Focus component, allowing only a minimal responsive shell overflow guard; this task measures experience continuity, not a broad redesign.

Expose the Station Focus DOM hooks exactly as specified — block class `station-focus`, route modifiers `station-focus--dashboard`/`station-focus--charts`/`station-focus--widgets`, tile class `station-focus__tile`, and chip buttons `station-focus__chip` carrying `data-focus-filter="all|new|recurring"` — using these class names on top of the CoreUI CCard/CButtonGroup/CBadge structure (the BEM hooks and CoreUI components coexist).
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial protect the original CoreUI admin shell (sidebar, header controls, widget cards, footer) and the new Station Focus filter card on the dashboard before any interaction.

desktop_traffic_focus scrolls the dashboard Station Focus card into view and verifies the default All-stations roster (the Harbor Yield & Stations rows) renders as wrapped station tiles with a live 'Showing 6 of 6 · All stations' readout.

desktop_traffic_day and desktop_traffic_year click the New and Recurring status chips and require the readout to re-sync to the filtered roster ('Showing 4 of 6 · New stations' / 'Showing 2 of 6 · Recurring stations'); a stale readout that never updates is a failed interaction.

desktop_charts_route and desktop_widgets_route verify the shared Station Focus cadence is echoed onto the Tide Charts and Station Widgets routes so the focus workflow stays consistent across every telemetry surface.
desktop_traffic_sales_table protects the Harbor Yield & Stations analytics panel and its table rows after the rebrand.
tablet_traffic_focus and mobile_traffic_focus require the Station Focus roster grid to wrap without horizontal overflow of the admin shell at tablet and phone widths.
mobile_sidebar_open opens the responsive sidebar and protects the mobile navigation after the change.

change_completion: The dashboard renders a native Station Focus card that reuses the Harbor Yield & Stations roster behind All / New / Recurring status chips with a live 'Showing N of M · <status> stations' readout.
The same Station Focus card is echoed onto the Tide Charts and Station Widgets routes; the shell keeps its Tidepool Analytics / Tide Overview / Tide Charts / Station Widgets rebrand.
regression: Original dashboard widgets, MainChart, WidgetsBrand row, Harbor Yield & Stations analytics table, avatar rows, header, sidebar, footer, Charts route, Widgets route, and mobile sidebar remain intact.
The Tidepool Analytics wordmark and Tide Overview navigation are present across routes.
design_consistency: The Station Focus card reuses CoreUI CRow/CCol, CBadge, CButton, CButtonGroup, rounded/border-start tiles and body-secondary label conventions and reuses the app's own station data.
The dashboard stays an admin analytics surface and does not become a modal, landing hero, or a separate synthetic metric-tile strip.
responsive: The Station Focus chip row and station grid wrap cleanly on tablet/mobile with no horizontal overflow.
The mobile sidebar toggle remains usable.
state_coverage: Captured states cover dashboard initial, Station Focus default (All), New/Recurring chip interactions, the Harbor Yield table, the Widgets route, the Charts route, tablet/mobile Station Focus, and the mobile sidebar.

metadata.design_goal: add a native status-filter card that reuses the console's own station roster and stays consistent across dashboard/charts/widgets routes while preserving structure
metadata.source_repo_kind: Vite React CoreUI admin dashboard with sidebar routes, dashboard widgets, charts, tables, avatar/image assets, header controls, theme menu, and responsive mobile sidebar
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused runnable Vite React CoreUI admin template that builds cleanly and exposes a full admin shell (sidebar/header/footer, dashboard, charts and widgets routes) — a natural cross-page experience-continuity rebrand target without external services.

author_notes: Slot slot_279 targets dashboard_admin / experience_continuity / modify / section / L4. The task adds a NATIVE 'Station Focus' filter card to the already-rebranded Tidepool Analytics CoreUI admin console: it reuses the dashboard's OWN Harbor Yield & Stations roster behind an All / New / Recurring status-chip filter with a live 'Showing N of M · <status> stations' readout, echoed across the dashboard, Tide Charts and Station Widgets routes, while preserving the CoreUI layout, routing, widgets, analytics table and responsive mobile sidebar. D3 host == D4 control == the same .station-focus card. Product-grade L4: D6 no_horizontal_overflow + D3 visual_regression + D2 cross-page dom_assertions + D4 interaction_assertions (status-chip readout re-sync), with a collapsed-illegible + stale-readout + widgets-omitted leg as the known-bad negative control.
